title: Dominari's other deals: Tron/SRM with Justin Sun, Kazakhstan tungsten, Chinese IPOs
summary: Every thread in the claim is documented. Dominari was exclusive placement agent on SRM Entertainment's June 2025 $100M (up to $210M) TRX treasury deal that made it Tron Inc. Eric Trump denies any role. Dominari controls 90% of the roughly $1B American Ventures, in which both sons are passive investors. The sons reportedly bought into Skyline Builders through a Dominari-linked SPV before Skyline took 20% of Cove's Kaz Resources, which holds up to $1.6B in non-binding EXIM/DFC letters of interest. The China-IPO scrutiny is a March 2026 House committee letter with no finding yet, and FINRA's October 2026 $800K Revere fine does not name Kyle Wool. No evidence shows the sons influenced any government decision.

sub_claims.statement: Dominari Securities arranged the SRM Entertainment to Tron Inc. reverse-merger treasury deal with Justin Sun.
sub_claims.finding: On June 16, 2025, SRM announced a $100M Series B convertible preferred sale (convertible at $0.50) plus 220M warrants, up to $210M in total, to fund a TRX treasury. SRM was renamed Tron Inc., Sun became an adviser, and Dominari Securities was exclusive placement agent. SRM rose roughly 460-580%. The investor, Bravemorning, exercised $110M of warrants in September 2025, bringing its total to $210M and about 86.6% ownership. The claim that Sun's father, Weike Sun, got board control rests on a single source and is unverified.

sub_claims.statement: Eric Trump is reportedly linked to the Tron deal and denies a role.
sub_claims.finding: His documented link is the Dominari advisory board and his stake in Dominari. Early reports said he was expected to take a role at Tron Inc. In June 2025 he posted on X: 'I am not involved in Tron's public listing plans.' No filing names him at Tron Inc.

sub_claims.statement: Dominari launched American Ventures, a roughly $1B microcap fund with Trump-son investors.
sub_claims.finding: American Ventures Management LLC is 90% owned by Dominari, according to a May 2026 SEC filing. The sons own roughly 12-13% of Dominari (Reuters reported 6.71% each from February 2025 filings) and, per the FT (May 2026), invested in most of the vehicles; amounts are undisclosed. Its stated focus is drones, AI and crypto. On June 25, 2026, Bloomberg reported hundreds of millions in unrealized, largely warrant-driven gains on at least 10 thinly traded microcaps, and Bloomberg Línea reported stake sales during media-driven price rises. '$1B' is the stated size, not confirmed capital raised.

sub_claims.statement: Dominari was tied to the Skyline Builders / Cove Kaz Kazakhstan tungsten deal, which has up to $1.6B of US-government-linked financing.
sub_claims.finding: The FT (about May 2026) reported that the sons bought into Skyline (SKBL) in August 2025 through an SPV run by a Dominari subsidiary / American Ventures. Its sources were anonymous, and SEC filings do not name the brothers. Timeline: Sept. 22, 2025, Tokayev reportedly tells Trump Cove Kaz will get the project; Oct. 28, an almost $24M Skyline placement in which the sons reportedly added to their stake; Oct. 31, Skyline agrees to pay $20M for 20% of Kaz Resources; Nov. 6, the deal is signed; then EXIM issues a letter of interest for up to $900M and DFC letters for $700M, all non-binding. In May 2026 Cove sought about $400M more from the Pentagon's Office of Strategic Capital. Skyline and Cove Kaz signed a merger agreement to form Kaz Resources (KAZR) in August 2026. The FT found no evidence of foreknowledge or influence.

sub_claims.statement: The House China Select Committee is probing Chinese small-cap 'ramp-and-dump' IPOs that Dominari underwrote.
sub_claims.finding: On March 8, 2026, Moolenaar and Khanna sent information-request letters to Dominari Securities, D. Boral Capital and Revere Securities, asking for records back to 2020. The committee says 11 of Dominari's 29 Chinese IPOs since 2020 fit a manipulative profile. These are letters, not subpoenas; one aggregator's subpoena claim is unconfirmed. No hearing, referral or finding had been located as of November 2026.

sub_claims.statement: FINRA fined Kyle Wool's former firm, Revere Securities.
sub_claims.finding: In October 2026 FINRA fined Revere $800,000 for AML and supervisory failures on foreign small-cap IPOs with ramp-and-dump hallmarks (about 60 IPOs since 2022). Revere did not admit or deny the findings. Wool was president of Revere Securities from about April to October 2022 and non-executive chairman until about April 2023, then became CEO of Dominari Securities in March 2023. The conduct period partly overlaps his tenure, but FINRA does not name him.

corrections: The $1.6B in 'US-government-linked financing' is non-binding letters of interest (EXIM up to $900M, DFC $700M), not disbursed funding. The project's development cost is about $1.1B.
Dominari's tie to the tungsten deal is indirect. The sons' Skyline stake reportedly went through a Dominari-subsidiary / American Ventures SPV, and Skyline then bought 20% of Kaz Resources.
The House committee action is information-request letters, not subpoenas or findings.
The FINRA action names Revere Securities, not Kyle Wool; whether the conduct overlaps his tenure is only partly established.
American Ventures' stated focus is drones, AI and crypto; 'microcap' describes what it holds, and '$1B' is its stated size.
denials_and_context: Eric Trump: 'I'm the biggest fan of Tron… I am not involved in Tron's public listing plans.'

Trump Organization retraction demand to the NYT: suggestions of the brothers' involvement are 'categorically false, misleading and libelous'; they had 'absolutely no involvement in the award.' The NYT said the letter 'does not deny the main point of our story.'

Eric Trump says he is 'a passive investor with absolutely no management role'; a Don Jr. spokesman says he 'does not interface with the federal government on behalf of any company.' Both call themselves passive investors in American Ventures.
Cove CEO Pini Althaus credited support from President Trump, Rubio and Lutnick, but said he never spoke to either Trump brother.
White House: 'The only special interest guiding the Trump administration's decision-making is the best interest of the American people.'
Dominari (March 16, 2026) said it will cooperate with the committee, that IPOs are under 10% of its banking revenue, and that it stopped Chinese IPO work in 2024 and Hong Kong IPO work in mid-2025.
Revere settled with FINRA without admitting or denying the findings.
Oversight so far is from Democrats: Warren's letters to Lutnick, Hegseth and EXIM (July 2026), a Blumenthal-Schiff-Warren letter, and CREW FOIA requests. No outcomes were found.
intellinews.com, foxnews.com and FT mirror pages were not read directly; findings rely on search excerpts across multiple outlets.
